name: drawio-skill
description: Generate draw.io diagrams from natural language — 11 presets (UML, SysML/MBSE, BPMN, network, C4…), 36 tools: codebase/CI/infra-to-diagram, image→editable diagram, mind maps, build-up animation, exec-view compression, click-through runbooks, PR diff bot. Vision self-check, 10,000+ shapes. Exports PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG.
